subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The patch adds a public Gateway route and optional plugin API, which is a product and compatibility boundary choice beyond the mechanical session-key bug.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, docs/scope semantics, and a clean merge result before merge.

options.title: Land read-only first
options.body: Limit the PR to capabilities/status/doctor and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that control operation.

options.title: Defer core API
options.body: Hold or close the core PR and keep context-engine control private/plugin-owned until a broader Gateway control contract is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, docs/scope semantics, and a clean merge result before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway operator scopes, session controls, and public API exposure where current main history points most strongly to steipete.
